labels: source-only labels independently reviewed before provider calls; not owner-gold
exposure: Source hashes do not match the local prior-run ledger. This is not a protected holdout; informal or model exposure cannot be ruled out.
scope: Search and Jev selection over one explicit Markdown source per case; metadataMode off. This does not measure automatic atom/source discovery, relationship synthesis, multsource union, or canonical writes.

providerPlan.candidatePolicy: pass only exact handles returned by the same query and source
providerPlan.emptyPoolPolicy: record not-run/no-search-candidates; do not invoke selector
providerPlan.postSelection: fetch exact handle, then evidence pack; compare source hash again after all calls

scoring: selector disposition and selected-range relation to frozen gold span
abstention correctness on source-absent questions, only when a candidate pool was offered
provider/model, latency and tokens when returned

cases.absentScope: The frozen source contains no Opus or bitrate specification.
